title: BalancePet changelog notices v1
description: Changes published outside a release: a specification gaining a section, a document being corrected, published content being rewritten. An entry never announces a new version -- that is the update check's job.

seq.description: Positive, unique, and strictly increasing with time. This is the watermark: a reader records the highest number it has shown, and everything above it is new.

date.description: For display only; nothing is compared against it, because a comparison at day resolution would let two notices published the same day hide each other.

area.description: Short category shown beside the date, such as 规范, 文档 or 在线内容.

summary.description: Where "what changed" is answered. A title alone rarely does.

url.description: Absolute https address to the change itself. Opened by the shell, so anything else is refused when the document is parsed.
